_readme: JoJo's Blocks — FREE RESOURCES LIBRARY (Part 5). The single source of truth for the 12 free downloadable resources listed on /free-resources/ and rendered as one detail page each at /free-resources/<slug>/ by tools/generate-pages.js (renderResourcePage, templates/resource.html). Every file must already exist under assets/free-resources/ and its byte size must match file_size_bytes, or the build fails — so a paid PDF can never be published as a free download by mistake. Categories are the fixed list below; each maps to a section category on the Free Resources landing page. page_orientation is 'portrait' except the weekly planner ('landscape'). is_pdf is false only for the wallpaper (the downloadable file is the JPG itself). Licence for all 12: 'Personal & family use'. Meta descriptions must be 120-160 characters.
